SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "comments" AS "c" INNER JOIN (SELECT postid FROM "comments" GROUP BY postid HAVING COUNT(*) = 1) AS "single_comment_posts" ON "c".postid = "single_comment_posts".postid INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "c".postid WHERE "c".score = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT "organizer".userid, "organizer".date FROM "badges" AS "organizer" INNER JOIN "users" ON "users".id = "organizer".userid WHERE "organizer".name = 'Organizer' AND "users".location ILIKE '%Germany%' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "badges" AS "earlier" WHERE "earlier".userid = "organizer".userid AND "earlier".date < "organizer".date) >= 5) AS "qualifying" LIMIT 501

WITH "first_posts" AS (SELECT owneruserid, MIN(creaiondate) AS "first_post_date" FROM "posts" WHERE owneruserid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY owneruserid) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "first_posts" AS "fp" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "fp".owneruserid WHERE "fp".first_post_date >= '2010-01-01'::TIMESTAMPTZ AND "fp".first_post_date < '2011-01-01'::TIMESTAMPTZ AND "u".location ILIKE '%India' AND ("u".location = 'India' OR "u".location ILIKE '%, India' OR "u".location ILIKE '%,India') LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(AVG("u".reputation)) FROM "posts" AS "p" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".owneruserid WHERE "p".tags ILIKE '%<r>%' AND "p".score < 20 LIMIT 501

WITH "p" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".score, "u".id AS "editor_id", "u".location, "u".reputation FROM "posts" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".lasteditoruserid WHERE "p".creaiondate >= '2012-01-01' AND "p".creaiondate < '2013-01-01'), "totals" AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(score) FILTER (WHERE location ILIKE '%Germany%'), 0) AS "germany_editor_posts_total_score", COALESCE(SUM(score) FILTER (WHERE location IS NULL OR location NOT ILIKE '%Germany%'), 0) AS "other_posts_total_score" FROM "p"), "germany_editors" AS (SELECT DISTINCT editor_id, reputation FROM "p" WHERE location ILIKE '%Germany%' AND editor_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT "totals".germany_editor_posts_total_score, "totals".other_posts_total_score, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "germany_editors") AS "germany_based_last_editors_count", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(reputation), 0) FROM "germany_editors") AS "combined_reputation" FROM "totals" LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("u".reputation), 0) AS "combined_reputation" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "p".owneruserid FROM "posts" AS "p" WHERE "p".score = 10 AND "p".tags LIKE '%<r>%' AND "p".owneruserid IS NOT NULL) AS "owners" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "owners".owneruserid LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("u".reputation) FROM "posts" AS "p" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".owneruserid WHERE "p".tags ILIKE '%<r>%' AND "p".lasactivitydate >= '2014-08-27'::DATE AND "p".lasactivitydate < '2014-08-28'::DATE LIMIT 501

SELECT id, displayname, views, reputation FROM "users" WHERE (location ILIKE '%California%' OR location ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])CA([^[:alnum:]]|$)') AND views = (SELECT MAX(views) FROM "users" WHERE location ILIKE '%California%' OR location ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])CA([^[:alnum:]]|$)') LIMIT 501

SELECT age FROM "users" WHERE location ILIKE '%York%' AND (location ILIKE '%York, England%' OR location = 'York') AND reputation = (SELECT MAX(reputation) FROM "users" WHERE location ILIKE '%York%' AND (location ILIKE '%York, England%' OR location = 'York')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "u".id) AS "count" FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN "badges" AS "b" ON "b".userid = "u".id WHERE "u".location ILIKE '%India%' AND "b".name = 'Yearling' AND "b".date < '2014-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "u".displayname) AS "display_name_count" FROM "badges" AS "b" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "b".userid WHERE "b".name = 'Supporter' AND "u".age BETWEEN 19 AND 65 LIMIT 501

WITH "matching_posts" AS (SELECT id, title FROM "posts" WHERE title ILIKE '%principal component scores%'), "related_counts" AS (SELECT "mp".id, "mp".title, COUNT("pl".id) AS "related_post_count" FROM "matching_posts" AS "mp" LEFT JOIN "postlinks" AS "pl" ON "pl".postid = "mp".id OR "pl".relatedpostid = "mp".id GROUP BY "mp".id, "mp".title), "ranked" AS (SELECT id, title, related_post_count, MAX(related_post_count) OVER () AS "max_related_post_count" FROM "related_counts") SELECT title, related_post_count FROM "ranked" WHERE related_post_count = max_related_post_count LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("uv".upvote_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_upvotes_cast", ROUND(AVG("u".age::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_age" FROM (SELECT owneruserid FROM "posts" WHERE creaiondate >= '2012-01-01' AND creaiondate < '2013-01-01' AND owneruserid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY owneruserid HAVING COUNT(*) > 10) AS "a" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "a".owneruserid LEFT JOIN (SELECT userid, COUNT(*) AS "upvote_count" FROM "votes" WHERE votetypeid = 2 GROUP BY userid) AS "uv" ON "uv".userid = "u".id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(monthly_count), 0)::NUMERIC / 12, 2) AS "average_monthly_posts" FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', "pl".creationdate) AS "month_start", COUNT(DISTINCT "pl".postid) AS "monthly_count" FROM "postlinks" AS "pl" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "pl".postid WHERE "pl".creationdate >= '2010-01-01' AND "pl".creationdate < '2011-01-01' AND "p".answercount <= 2 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', "pl".creationdate)) AS "monthly_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "u".reputation < 1000 OR "p".owneruserid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "posts" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "p".owneruserid = "u".id WHERE "p".creaiondate >= '2010-01-01' AND "p".creaiondate < '2011-01-01' AND "p".score > 5 LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF("h".userdisplayname, ''), "u".displayname) AS "editor_display_name", COUNT(*) AS "edit_comment_count" FROM "posts" AS "p" INNER JOIN "posthistory" AS "h" ON "h".postid = "p".id LEFT JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "h".userid WHERE "p".title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?' AND "h".comment IS NOT NULL AND "h".comment <> '' GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF("h".userdisplayname, ''), "u".displayname) ORDER BY edit_comment_count DESC LIMIT 501

WITH "totals" AS (SELECT "c".segment, "c".customerid, SUM("y".consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'CZK' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND "y".date >= '2013-01' AND "y".date < '2014-01' GROUP BY "c".segment, "c".customerid), "ranked" AS (SELECT segment, customerid, total_consumption, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total_consumption ASC, customerid ASC) AS "rn" FROM "totals"), "winners" AS (SELECT segment, customerid, total_consumption FROM "ranked" WHERE rn = 1) SELECT ROUND((MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME') - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "sme_minus_lam", ROUND((MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM') - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "lam_minus_kam", ROUND((MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM') - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "kam_minus_sme" FROM "winners" LIMIT 501

WITH "totals" AS (SELECT "c".segment, SUM("y".consumption) FILTER (WHERE "y".date >= '2012-01' AND "y".date < '2013-01') AS "total_2012", SUM("y".consumption) FILTER (WHERE "y".date >= '2013-01' AND "y".date < '2014-01') AS "total_2013" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') GROUP BY "c".segment), "increases" AS (SELECT segment, (total_2013 - total_2012) * 100.0 / total_2012 AS "increase_pct" FROM "totals") SELECT segment, ROUND(increase_pct::NUMERIC, 2) AS "increase_percentage" FROM "increases" WHERE increase_pct = (SELECT MAX(increase_pct) FROM "increases") OR increase_pct = (SELECT MIN(increase_pct) FROM "increases") ORDER BY increase_pct DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(((SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END))::NUMERIC, 4) AS "relative_change" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE customerid = 6718 AND SUBSTRING(date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".customerid) FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y2012" ON "y2012".customerid = "c".customerid INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y2013" ON "y2013".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR' AND "y2012".date >= '2012-01' AND "y2012".date < '2013-01' AND "y2013".date >= '2013-01' AND "y2013".date < '2014-01' AND "y2012".consumption > 0 AND "y2013".consumption > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".segment, COUNT(DISTINCT "y".customerid) AS "customers_who_consumed_fuel" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "y".date >= '2013-01' AND "y".date < '2014-01' AND "y".consumption > 0 GROUP BY "c".segment LIMIT 501

SELECT FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX("t".date + "t".time::TIME) - MIN("t".date + "t".time::TIME))) / 60) AS "elapsed_whole_minutes" FROM "transactions_1k" AS "t" INNER JOIN "gasstations" AS "g" ON "t".gasstationid = "g".gasstationid WHERE "g".country = 'CZE' AND "t".price > 1000 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".currency, COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM (SELECT "ym".customerid FROM "yearmonth" AS "ym" WHERE "ym".date >= '2013-01' AND "ym".date < '2013-12' AND "ym".consumption > 0 GROUP BY "ym".customerid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "ym".date) = 11) AS "active" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "active".customerid GROUP BY "c".currency LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".currency, ROUND(AVG("q".quarter_consumption)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_quarter_consumption" FROM (SELECT customerid, SUM(consumption) AS "quarter_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE date >= '2013-04-01' AND date < '2013-07-01' GROUP BY customerid) AS "q" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "q".customerid GROUP BY "c".currency ORDER BY "c".currency ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "monthly_totals" AS (SELECT "date", SUM(consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE "date" >= '201201' AND "date" < '201401' GROUP BY "date"), "yearly_peaks" AS (SELECT LEFT("date", 4) AS "year", MAX(total_consumption) AS "peak_total" FROM "monthly_totals" GROUP BY LEFT("date", 4)) SELECT ROUND(MAX(peak_total) FILTER (WHERE year = '2013') - MAX(peak_total) FILTER (WHERE year = '2012')) AS "difference" FROM "yearly_peaks" LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(AVG(consumption)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_monthly_fuel_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE customerid = 15621 AND "date" >= '201301' AND "date" < '201401' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN (SELECT customerid, SUM(consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE date >= '2013-01' AND date < '2014-01' GROUP BY customerid HAVING SUM(consumption) > 1000000) AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".segment = 'KAM' AND "c".currency = 'CZK' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "t".customerid) FROM "transactions_1k" AS "t" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "t".customerid WHERE "c".segment = 'SME' AND "t".date >= DATE '2013-02-01' AND "t".date < DATE '2013-03-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".team_long_name FROM "match" AS "m" INNER JOIN "team" AS "t" ON "t".team_api_id = "m".away_team_api_id INNER JOIN "league" AS "l" ON "l".id = "m".league_id WHERE "l".name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND "m".season = '2009/2010' AND "m".away_team_goal > "m".home_team_goal GROUP BY "t".team_long_name HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(away_wins) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "away_wins" FROM "match" AS "m2" INNER JOIN "league" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "m2".league_id WHERE "l2".name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND "m2".season = '2009/2010' AND "m2".away_team_goal > "m2".home_team_goal GROUP BY "m2".away_team_api_id) AS "win_counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT "l".name FROM "league" AS "l" INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".league_id = "l".id WHERE "m".season = '2009/2010' GROUP BY "l".id, "l".name HAVING AVG("m".home_team_goal) > AVG("m".away_team_goal) LIMIT 501

WITH "extremes" AS (SELECT "p".player_api_id, "p".player_name FROM "player" AS "p" WHERE "p".height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM "player") UNION ALL SELECT "p".player_api_id, "p".player_name FROM "player" AS "p" WHERE "p".height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM "player")), "averages" AS (SELECT "e".player_name, AVG("pa".finishing) AS "avg_finishing" FROM "extremes" AS "e" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "e".player_api_id WHERE "pa".finishing IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".player_api_id, "e".player_name) SELECT player_name FROM "averages" ORDER BY avg_finishing DESC LIMIT 1

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT "p".player_name, "pa".overall_rating, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "p".player_api_id ORDER BY "pa".date DESC, "pa".id DESC) AS "rn" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".player_name IN ('Ariel Borysiuk', 'Paulin Puel')) SELECT ROUND((MAX(overall_rating) FILTER (WHERE player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk') - MAX(overall_rating) FILTER (WHERE player_name = 'Paulin Puel'))::NUMERIC * 100 / MAX(overall_rating) FILTER (WHERE player_name = 'Paulin Puel'), 2) AS "percentage_higher" FROM "latest" WHERE rn = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "pa".date FROM "player_attributes" AS "pa" INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".player_name = 'Kevin Constant' AND "pa".crossing = (SELECT MAX("pa2".crossing) FROM "player_attributes" AS "pa2" INNER JOIN "player" AS "p2" ON "pa2".player_api_id = "p2".player_api_id WHERE "p2".player_name = 'Kevin Constant') ORDER BY "pa".date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * ("d".overall_rating - "a".avg_rating) / "a".avg_rating, 2) AS "percentage_higher" FROM (SELECT "pa".overall_rating FROM "player_attributes" AS "pa" INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id = "pa".player_api_id WHERE "p".player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND "pa".date::TIMESTAMP <= TIMESTAMP '2013-07-12 23:59:59' AND "pa".defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high') ORDER BY "pa".date::TIMESTAMP DESC LIMIT 1) AS "d" CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG("x".overall_rating) AS "avg_rating" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, overall_rating, defensive_work_rate FROM "player_attributes" WHERE date::TIMESTAMP <= TIMESTAMP '2013-07-12 23:59:59' ORDER BY player_api_id ASC, date::TIMESTAMP DESC) AS "x" WHERE "x".defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')) AS "a" LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * ("end_tx".balance - "start_tx".balance) / NULLIF("start_tx".balance, 0) AS "percentage_increase" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "start_tx" ON "start_tx".account_id = "l".account_id AND "start_tx".date = DATE '1993-03-22' INNER JOIN "trans" AS "end_tx" ON "end_tx".account_id = "l".account_id AND "end_tx".date = DATE '1998-12-27' WHERE "l".date = DATE '1993-07-05' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".a2 AS "district", ROUND((("d".a13 - "d".a12) / NULLIF("d".a12, 0) * 100)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "unemployment_rate_percentage_change" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "l".status = 'D' AND "d".a12 IS NOT NULL AND "d".a13 IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) = 1997 THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) = 1996 THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) = 1996 THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "percentage_growth" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "l".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND "l".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1998-01-01' LIMIT 501
SELECT "a".frequency, "o".k_symbol FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".account_id = 3 AND "o".amount = 3539 LIMIT 501

WITH "first_month" AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(date)) AS "start_date" FROM "account"), "opened_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" CROSS JOIN "first_month" AS "f" WHERE "a".date >= "f".start_date AND "a".date < "f".start_date + INTERVAL '1 month') SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a8 AS "inhabitants" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "opened_districts" AS "od" ON "od".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a8 = (SELECT MAX("d2".a8) FROM "district" AS "d2" INNER JOIN "opened_districts" AS "od2" ON "od2".district_id = "d2".district_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "t".trans_id) FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "t".account_id = "d".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "d".client_id = "c".client_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01' AND "t".k_symbol = ' ' LIMIT 501

WITH "top_districts" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name" FROM "district" AS "d" ORDER BY "d".a8 DESC LIMIT 5), "district_metrics" AS (SELECT "td".district_id, "td".district_name, SUM(CASE WHEN "l".status IN ('C', 'D') THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "avg_active_loan_per_account" FROM "top_districts" AS "td" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "td".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "td".district_id, "td".district_name), "ranked" AS (SELECT district_name, ROUND(avg_active_loan_per_account) AS "average_active_loan_per_account", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_active_loan_per_account DESC) AS "burden_rank" FROM "district_metrics") SELECT district_name, average_active_loan_per_account FROM "ranked" WHERE burden_rank = 1 LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", "l".amount FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND ("l".date + ("l".duration * INTERVAL '1 month'))::DATE >= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D')), "totals" AS (SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "eligible" GROUP BY region) SELECT region, total_amount FROM "totals" WHERE total_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_amount) FROM "totals") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Bohemia' AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "t".bank = 'AB' LIMIT 501

WITH "served" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "branch".district_id FROM "district" AS "branch" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "branch".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "branch".a3 = 'east Bohemia' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1990-01-01') SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a12)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary", COUNT(*) AS "district_count" FROM "served" AS "s" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "s".district_id LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_clients" AS (SELECT "c".client_id, "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".client_id = "c".client_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "disp" AS "account_disp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "account_disp".disp_id WHERE "account_disp".account_id = "owner_disp".account_id)) SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM "eligible_clients") AS "eligible_districts" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "eligible_districts".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_loans_per_account" FROM "disp" AS "owner_disp" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "owner_disp".client_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "owner_disp".account_id WHERE "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01' LIMIT 501

WITH "cohort_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976), "counted" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS "household_payments", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol <> 'SIPO' AND "t".k_symbol <> ' ') AS "other_purpose_payments" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "cohort_accounts" AS "ca" ON "ca".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".amount > 4000) SELECT household_payments, other_purpose_payments FROM "counted" LIMIT 501

WITH "borrowing_accounts" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opening_date", SUM("l".amount) AS "total_borrowed" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "branch" ON "branch".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "branch".a2 = 'Prachatice' GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".date), "owners" AS (SELECT "d".account_id, "c".district_id AS "home_district_id" FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER'), "counterparties" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "t".account) AS "counterparty_count" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".account_id), "ranked" AS (SELECT "b".account_id, "b".opening_date, "b".total_borrowed, COALESCE("cp".counterparty_count, 0) AS "counterparty_count", "home".a2 AS "home_district", "home".a8 AS "population", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "home".a8 DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "borrowing_accounts" AS "b" INNER JOIN "owners" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "b".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "home" ON "home".district_id = "o".home_district_id LEFT JOIN "counterparties" AS "cp" ON "cp".account_id = "b".account_id) SELECT account_id, opening_date, total_borrowed, counterparty_count, home_district, population, population_rank FROM "ranked" ORDER BY population DESC, account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "account_avg" AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS "avg_balance" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id), "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c".gender, "d".district_id, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "salary", "d".a13 AS "urban_ratio" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "card_disp" ON "ca".disp_id = "card_disp".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "card_disp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "card_disp".account_id AND "owner_disp".client_id = "c".client_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "card_disp".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "account_avg" AS "aa" ON "aa".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "ca".type = 'gold' AND "aa".avg_balance > 1000 AND "d".a4::BIGINT > 100000), "district_stats" AS (SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS "district_count", MAX(inhabitants) AS "max_inhabitants", AVG(salary::NUMERIC) AS "avg_salary", AVG(urban_ratio::NUMERIC) AS "avg_urban_ratio" FROM "qualifying_districts" GROUP BY gender) SELECT CASE "ds".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 'women' ELSE 'men' END AS "gender", "ds".district_count, "qd".district_id, "ds".max_inhabitants AS "inhabitants", ROUND("ds".avg_salary, 2) AS "average_salary", ROUND("ds".avg_urban_ratio, 2) AS "average_urban_inhabitant_ratio" FROM "district_stats" AS "ds" INNER JOIN "qualifying_districts" AS "qd" ON "qd".gender = "ds".gender AND "qd".inhabitants = "ds".max_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE "ds".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, "qd".district_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "pair_totals" AS (SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "od" ON "od".account_id = "a".account_id AND "od".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "od".disp_id AND "c".type = 'gold' WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".operation = 'PREVOD NA UCET' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "d".a4::BIGINT >= 250000 GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account) SELECT bank, account, payment_count, total_amount FROM "pair_totals" WHERE total_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_amount) FROM "pair_totals") ORDER BY bank ASC, account ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM("t".amount), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Pisek' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".k_symbol <> ' ' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "dp".account_id, "dp".disp_id, "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "cr" ON "cr".disp_id = "dp".disp_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "dp".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "dp".type = 'OWNER'), "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM "eligible_accounts"), "regional_averages" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary", ROUND(AVG("d".a12)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_1996_unemployment_rate" FROM "qualifying_districts" AS "q" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "q".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3), "populous_districts" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a2 AS "district_name", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "d".a3 ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC, "d".a2 ASC) AS "rank" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "qualifying_districts" AS "q" ON "q".district_id = "d".district_id) SELECT "ra".region, "ra".average_district_salary, "ra".average_1996_unemployment_rate, "pd".district_name AS "most_populous_district" FROM "regional_averages" AS "ra" INNER JOIN "populous_districts" AS "pd" ON "pd".region = "ra".region AND "pd".rank = 1 ORDER BY "ra".region ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "client_card_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "ca"."type" AS "card_type", "d".a2 AS "home_district", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id WHERE "ca"."type" IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')), "ranked" AS (SELECT card_type, home_district, inhabitants, MIN(inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY card_type) AS "min_inhabitants" FROM "client_card_districts") SELECT card_type, home_district, inhabitants FROM "ranked" WHERE inhabitants = min_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE card_type WHEN 'gold' THEN 1 WHEN 'classic' THEN 2 WHEN 'junior' THEN 3 END ASC, home_district ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "target_region" AS (SELECT a3 FROM "district" WHERE a2 = 'Litomerice'), "opened" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = (SELECT a3 FROM "target_region") AND "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01'), "last_trans" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("t".account_id) "t".account_id, "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "opened" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY "t".account_id ASC, "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC), "district_stats" AS (SELECT "o".district_name, AVG("lt".balance)::NUMERIC AS "avg_balance" FROM "opened" AS "o" INNER JOIN "last_trans" AS "lt" ON "lt".account_id = "o".account_id GROUP BY "o".district_name) SELECT district_name AS "district_with_highest_average_end_of_1996_balance" FROM "district_stats" ORDER BY avg_balance DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "top_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "a".district_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC LIMIT 10), "district_set" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "d".a11::BIGINT AS "average_yearly_salary" FROM "top_loans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "t".district_id), "most_populous" AS (SELECT district_id, inhabitants FROM "district_set" ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT "m".district_id, "m".inhabitants, ROUND(AVG("ds".average_yearly_salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district_set" AS "ds" CROSS JOIN "most_populous" AS "m" GROUP BY "m".district_id, "m".inhabitants LIMIT 501

WITH "withdrawal_totals" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("t".amount) AS "total_withdrawn" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY "a".district_id), "standing_order_totals" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("o".amount) AS "standing_order_debit" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "a".district_id), "district_accounts" AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS "account_count" FROM "account" GROUP BY district_id) SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4 AS "population", "w".total_withdrawn, ROUND("w".total_withdrawn::NUMERIC / NULLIF("d".a4::NUMERIC, 0), 2) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "w".total_withdrawn::NUMERIC / NULLIF("d".a4::NUMERIC, 0) DESC) AS "rank", ROUND(COALESCE("s".standing_order_debit, 0)::NUMERIC / NULLIF("da".account_count, 0), 2) AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "withdrawal_totals" AS "w" ON "w".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "district_accounts" AS "da" ON "da".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "standing_order_totals" AS "s" ON "s".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a4::NUMERIC >= 100000 ORDER BY rank ASC, district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "client_home" AS (SELECT client_id, district_id FROM "client" WHERE client_id = 3541), "region_metrics" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT(DISTINCT "c".client_id) AS "client_count", (ARRAY_AGG("d".district_id ORDER BY "d".a8 DESC, "d".district_id ASC))[1] AS "most_populous_district_id", MAX("d".a8) AS "inhabitants" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".district_id = "d".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3), "district_ranks" AS (SELECT district_id, a3 AS "region", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a8 DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "district"), "transaction_stats" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_income", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_expense" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "account_opened", "a".frequency, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", CASE WHEN "d".district_id = "ch".district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "is_home_district", "d".a12 AS "average_salary", COALESCE("l".status, 'none') AS "loan_repayment_status", COALESCE("l".amount, 0) AS "loan_amount", COALESCE("ts".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("ts".total_income, 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE("ts".total_expense, 0) AS "total_expense", COALESCE("ts".total_income, 0) - COALESCE("ts".total_expense, 0) AS "net_balance", "rm".client_count AS "region_client_count", "mp".a2 AS "most_populous_district_name", "rm".inhabitants AS "most_populous_district_inhabitants", "dr".population_rank AS "account_district_population_rank" FROM "client_home" AS "ch" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "ch".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN "transaction_stats" AS "ts" ON "ts".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "region_metrics" AS "rm" ON "rm".region = "d".a3 INNER JOIN "district" AS "mp" ON "mp".district_id = "rm".most_populous_district_id INNER JOIN "district_ranks" AS "dr" ON "dr".district_id = "d".district_id ORDER BY COALESCE("ts".transaction_count, 0) DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "account_loans" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date, COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0) AS "amount_lent" FROM "account" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date), "district_year" AS (SELECT TO_CHAR("al".date, 'YYYY') AS "opening_year", "al".district_id, COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", SUM("al".amount_lent) AS "amount_lent", SUM("al".amount_lent)::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS "lent_per_account" FROM "account_loans" AS "al" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "al".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' GROUP BY TO_CHAR("al".date, 'YYYY'), "al".district_id) SELECT opening_year, SUM(accounts_opened) AS "accounts_opened", SUM(amount_lent) AS "total_amount_lent", ROUND(AVG(lent_per_account), 2) AS "average_district_amount_lent_per_account" FROM "district_year" GROUP BY opening_year ORDER BY opening_year ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".date, "a".district_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".date ASC, "l".loan_id ASC) AS "rn" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'), "top_ten" AS (SELECT loan_id, account_id, amount, date, district_id FROM "eligible" WHERE rn <= 10) SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "t".amount AS "approved_amount", "t".date AS "approval_date", "x".balance AS "end_of_day_account_balance" FROM "top_ten" AS "t" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "t".district_id INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "tr".balance FROM "trans" AS "tr" WHERE "tr".account_id = "t".account_id AND "tr".date = "t".date ORDER BY "tr".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "x" ON TRUE ORDER BY "t".amount DESC, "t".date ASC, "t".loan_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "card_clients" AS (SELECT "c".client_id, "c".gender, "c".birth_date, "ca".type AS "card_type", "ca".issued, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date)::INTEGER AS "age_at_issue", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a11 AS "district_average_salary", "di".account_id FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "di" ON "ca".disp_id = "di".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "di".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "c".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "ca".issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "ca".issued < DATE '1995-01-01'), "account_loans" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_loans", SUM(amount) AS "total_amount_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id), "profiled" AS (SELECT "cc".client_id, "cc".gender, "cc".birth_date, "cc".card_type, "cc".age_at_issue, COALESCE("al".number_of_loans, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("al".total_amount_borrowed, 0) AS "total_amount_borrowed", CASE WHEN COALESCE("al".number_of_loans, 0) > 0 AND "cc".age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' WHEN COALESCE("al".number_of_loans, 0) > 0 AND "cc".age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower' ELSE 'Non-borrower' END AS "borrower_classification", "cc".district_name, "cc".district_average_salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "cc".gender ORDER BY "cc".age_at_issue ASC) AS "age_rank_within_gender" FROM "card_clients" AS "cc" LEFT JOIN "account_loans" AS "al" ON "cc".account_id = "al".account_id) SELECT client_id, gender, birth_date, card_type, age_at_issue, number_of_loans, total_amount_borrowed, borrower_classification, district_name, district_average_salary, age_rank_within_gender FROM "profiled" ORDER BY client_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "branch_name", COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "transaction_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Moravia' AND "t".date <= DATE '1998-10-14' AND ("t".k_symbol IS NULL OR "t".k_symbol = '') GROUP BY "d".a2 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".loan_id = 98832 AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date < DATE '1996-01-03' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "a".district_id = 1 AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "t"."k_symbol" = 'UROK' THEN "t".amount WHEN "t"."k_symbol" = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -"t".amount ELSE 0 END) AS "net_interest_czk" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "d".client_id = 2823 AND "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t"."k_symbol" IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK') LIMIT 501

WITH "female_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".duration, "l".payments, "l".status, "c".client_id, "c".birth_date, "bd".a2 AS "branch_district", "bd".a3 AS "region" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "bd" ON "bd".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F'), "top_loans" AS (SELECT * FROM "female_loans" WHERE amount >= (SELECT amount FROM "female_loans" ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2)), "account_stats" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN "t".type = 'PRIJEM' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_deposits" FROM "trans" AS "t" GROUP BY "t".account_id), "region_loan_counts" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3), "region_salaries" AS (SELECT a3 AS "region", ROUND(AVG(a10)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_of_district_average_salaries" FROM "district" GROUP BY a3) SELECT "tl".client_id, "tl".amount AS "loan_amount", "tl".duration AS "duration_months", ROUND(("tl".payments * "tl".duration)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_payments", ROUND(("tl".payments * "tl".duration - "tl".amount)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "interest_paid", "tl".status AS "loan_status", "tl".branch_district, "tl".region, COALESCE("ast".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", ROUND(COALESCE("ast".total_deposits, 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_deposits", CASE WHEN COALESCE("ast".total_deposits, 0) > 2 * "tl".amount THEN 'High Income' WHEN COALESCE("ast".total_deposits, 0) > "tl".amount THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS "income_category", "rlc".loan_count AS "loans_granted_in_region", "rs".average_of_district_average_salaries, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "tl".birth_date))::INTEGER AS "completed_age" FROM "top_loans" AS "tl" LEFT JOIN "account_stats" AS "ast" ON "ast".account_id = "tl".account_id LEFT JOIN "region_loan_counts" AS "rlc" ON "rlc".region = "tl".region LEFT JOIN "region_salaries" AS "rs" ON "rs".region = "tl".region ORDER BY "tl".amount DESC LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_accounts" AS (SELECT account_id FROM "loan" WHERE duration > 24 AND date < DATE '1997-01-01'), "account_district" AS (SELECT "qa".account_id, "a".district_id, "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a8 AS "inhabitants", "d".a2 AS "district_name" FROM "qualifying_accounts" AS "qa" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "qa".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id), "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT region, district_id, district_name, inhabitants FROM "account_district") SELECT region, district_name FROM "qualifying_districts" ORDER BY region ASC, district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "gold_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "card" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".disp_id = "c".disp_id WHERE "c".type = 'gold'), "tx" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN "t".type = 'PRIJEM' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) AS "amount_received", SUM(CASE WHEN "t".type = 'VYDAJ' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) AS "amount_withdrawn", COUNT(DISTINCT "t".bank || ':' || "t".account::TEXT) FILTER (WHERE "t".operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU')) AS "counterparties" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "gold_accounts" AS "g" ON "g".account_id = "t".account_id GROUP BY "t".account_id), "lc" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "gold_accounts" AS "g" ON "g".account_id = "l".account_id GROUP BY "l".account_id) SELECT "g".account_id, "district".a2 AS "district_name", "district".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("tx".amount_received, 0) AS "total_amount_received", COALESCE("tx".amount_withdrawn, 0) AS "total_amount_withdrawn", COALESCE("lc".loan_count, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("tx".counterparties, 0) AS "external_counterparties", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("tx".counterparties, 0) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "gold_accounts" AS "g" INNER JOIN "account" ON "account".account_id = "g".account_id INNER JOIN "district" ON "district".district_id = "account".district_id LEFT JOIN "tx" ON "tx".account_id = "g".account_id LEFT JOIN "lc" ON "lc".account_id = "g".account_id ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC, "g".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "target_accounts" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opened_date" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Tabor' AND "a".date <= DATE '1996-12-31'), "owner_info" AS (SELECT "ta".account_id, "c".gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '1996-12-31', "c".birth_date))::INTEGER AS "owner_age" FROM "target_accounts" AS "ta" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "ta".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id), "card_counts" AS (SELECT "dp".account_id, COUNT("ca".card_id) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * ("last_finisher".milliseconds - "winner".milliseconds) / "last_finisher".milliseconds, 2) AS "percentage_shorter" FROM (SELECT "r".raceid FROM "races" AS "r" WHERE "r".year = 1988 AND "r".name = 'Australian Grand Prix') AS "race" INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "res".milliseconds FROM "results" AS "res" WHERE "res".raceid = "race".raceid AND "res".positionorder = 1) AS "winner" ON TRUE INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "res".milliseconds FROM "results" AS "res" WHERE "res".raceid = "race".raceid AND "res".laps = (SELECT MAX("res2".laps) FROM "results" AS "res2" WHERE "res2".raceid = "race".raceid) AND "res".milliseconds IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "res".positionorder DESC LIMIT 1) AS "last_finisher" ON TRUE LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("res".points) AS "score", "c".name, "c".nationality FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "ci" ON "ci".circuitid = "r".circuitid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "c".constructorid = "res".constructorid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 AND ("r".name ILIKE '%Monaco Grand Prix%' OR "ci".name ILIKE '%Monaco%') GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".nationality ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".position <= 10) AND "q".position <= 10 LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, COUNT("p".stop) AS "total_pit_stops" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "ds".raceid FROM "driverstandings" AS "ds" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "ds".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Australian' AND "ds".position BETWEEN 1 AND 19) AS "eligible_races" ON "eligible_races".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013 GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 <> '' AND (SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) > 120 LIMIT 501

WITH "september_stops" AS (SELECT "p".raceid, "p".driverid, "p".milliseconds, "r".name AS "race_name", "c".name AS "circuit_name", "c".location AS "circuit_location", "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_name" FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "p".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "p".driverid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r".date < DATE '2016-10-01'), "fastest" AS (SELECT MIN(milliseconds) AS "milliseconds" FROM "september_stops") SELECT "s".driver_name, TO_CHAR(("s".milliseconds / 1000.0)::NUMERIC, 'FM999999990.000') || ' seconds' AS "pit_stop_time", "s".race_name, "s".circuit_name, "s".circuit_location FROM "september_stops" AS "s" INNER JOIN "fastest" AS "f" ON "f".milliseconds = "s".milliseconds LIMIT 501

WITH "winning_drivers" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".driverid, "d".dob, "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "res".position = 1 AND "ra".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017), "oldest" AS (SELECT driverid FROM "winning_drivers" ORDER BY dob ASC, forename || ' ' || surname ASC LIMIT 1), "first_win" AS (SELECT "ra".name, "ra".date FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "oldest" AS "o" ON "o".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "res".position = 1 AND "ra".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 ORDER BY "ra".date ASC, "ra".name ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "full_name", "d".nationality, "fw".name AS "first_win_race", "fw".date AS "first_win_date", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "res".driverid = "d".driverid AND "ra".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017) AS "races_started" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "oldest" AS "o" ON "o".driverid = "d".driverid CROSS JOIN "first_win" AS "fw" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) AS "runnings" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Accident' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "c".name FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "q".constructorid = "c".constructorid INNER JOIN "results" AS "re" ON "re".raceid = "q".raceid AND "re".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "q".q2 ASC, "re".grid ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT "d".surname, "r".name FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 = (SELECT MIN(q2) FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 = (SELECT "q2".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "q2".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".position = 1 LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".code, "q".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3::INTERVAL = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3::INTERVAL) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".position = 1 LIMIT 501

WITH "editions" AS (SELECT "r".raceid, "r".year, "r".time, "res".driverid, "res".positionorder, "res".milliseconds, "res".time AS "result_time", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "r".raceid ORDER BY "res".positionorder ASC) AS "finish_rank" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009), "earliest" AS (SELECT year, raceid, time FROM "editions" GROUP BY year, raceid, time ORDER BY time ASC, year DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT "e".year, "winner".time AS "winner_time", "runner".result_time AS "runner_up_time", "runner".milliseconds - "winner".milliseconds AS "time_gap_milliseconds" FROM "earliest" AS "e" INNER JOIN "editions" AS "winner" ON "winner".raceid = "e".raceid AND "winner".finish_rank = 1 INNER JOIN "editions" AS "runner" ON "runner".raceid = "e".raceid AND "runner".positionorder = 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".code FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' ORDER BY "d".code ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "d".forename, "d".surname, "res".time FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND "r".time <= '17:00:00' AND "res".position = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 < '1:38.000' LIMIT 501

WITH "race_times" AS (SELECT "ci".circuitref, "r".time::TIME AS "start_time" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "ci" ON "ci".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".time IS NOT NULL), "extremes" AS (SELECT MIN(start_time) AS "earliest_time", MAX(start_time) AS "latest_time" FROM "race_times") SELECT (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "rt".circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY "rt".circuitref ASC) FROM "race_times" AS "rt" CROSS JOIN "extremes" AS "e" WHERE "rt".start_time = "e".earliest_time) AS "earliest_circuit_refs", (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "rt".circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY "rt".circuitref ASC) FROM "race_times" AS "rt" CROSS JOIN "extremes" AS "e" WHERE "rt".start_time = "e".latest_time) AS "latest_circuit_refs", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("e".latest_time - "e".earliest_time)) AS "gap_seconds" FROM "extremes" AS "e" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1991-01-01' AND "r".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND "r".fastestlapspeed <> '' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".dob ORDER BY MAX(NULLIF("r".fastestlapspeed, '')::NUMERIC) DESC, "d".dob ASC, "d".surname ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 IS NULL ORDER BY "q".q1 DESC, "d".driverid ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "res".driverid) FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "res".statusid = "s".statusid INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "res".raceid = "ra".raceid WHERE "ra".year = 1962 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Withdrew' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "res".position IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "ra".year = 1957 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "mean_total_expense_per_event" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("e".cost) AS "event_total" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Elijah' AND "m".last_name = 'Allen' AND "e".expense_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".expense_date < '2019-11-01' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "per_event" LIMIT 501
SELECT notes FROM "income" WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b1".amount::NUMERIC / NULLIF("b2".amount, 0) AS "ratio" FROM "budget" AS "b1" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e1" ON "b1".link_to_event = "e1".event_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b2" ON "b2".category = "b1".category INNER JOIN "event" AS "e2" ON "b2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id WHERE "b1".category = 'Advertisement' AND "e1".event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' AND "e2".event_name = 'October Meeting' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name HAVING SUM("b".spent) / NULLIF(SUM("b".amount), 0) = (SELECT MAX(event_ratio) FROM (SELECT SUM("b2".spent) / NULLIF(SUM("b2".amount), 0) AS "event_ratio" FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b2" ON "b2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id WHERE "e2".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e2".event_id) AS "ratios") LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name || ' ' || "m".last_name AS "name" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) > 7 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, "m".phone FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "e".cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM "expense") LIMIT 501

WITH "fall_events" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id), "fall_average" AS (SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendee_count)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_attendance" FROM "fall_events"), "womens_soccer" AS (SELECT COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'Women''s Soccer' GROUP BY "e".event_id) SELECT "ws".attendee_count, "fa".average_attendance, CASE WHEN "ws".attendee_count > "fa".average_attendance THEN 'more' WHEN "ws".attendee_count < "fa".average_attendance THEN 'fewer' ELSE 'equal' END AS "verdict" FROM "womens_soccer" AS "ws" CROSS JOIN "fall_average" AS "fa" LIMIT 501

WITH "college_majors" AS (SELECT major_id, major_name, department FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'), "per_major" AS (SELECT "cm".department, "cm".major_id, "cm".major_name, COUNT("m".member_id) AS "member_count" FROM "college_majors" AS "cm" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".link_to_major = "cm".major_id GROUP BY "cm".department, "cm".major_id, "cm".major_name), "department_metrics" AS (SELECT department, STRING_AGG(major_name, ', ' ORDER BY major_name ASC) AS "majors_offered", STRING_AGG(major_name, ', ' ORDER BY major_name ASC) FILTER (WHERE member_count > 0) AS "majors_held", ROUND(AVG(member_count)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_members_per_major" FROM "per_major" GROUP BY department) SELECT department, majors_offered, COALESCE(majors_held, '') AS "majors_held", average_members_per_major FROM "department_metrics" ORDER BY department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e"."type" AS "event_type", COALESCE("att".members_attended, 0) AS "members_attended", COALESCE("bud".total_budgeted_amount, 0) AS "total_budgeted_amount" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "type" FROM "event" WHERE event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND event_date < '2020-01-01') AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "ev"."type", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "members_attended" FROM "event" AS "ev" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "ev".event_id WHERE "ev".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "ev".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "ev"."type") AS "att" ON "att"."type" = "e"."type" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "ev"."type", SUM("b".amount) AS "total_budgeted_amount" FROM "event" AS "ev" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "ev".event_id WHERE "ev".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "ev".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "ev"."type") AS "bud" ON "bud"."type" = "e"."type" ORDER BY "e"."type" ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, ROUND(SUM("b".amount - "b".spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_amount_left" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "e".link_to_budget WHERE "e".cost > 50 GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name ORDER BY total_amount_left DESC, "m".last_name ASC, "m".first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("i".amount) AS "total_dues_dollars" FROM "income" AS "i" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "i".link_to_member INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "a".link_to_event WHERE "i".source = 'Dues' AND "e".type = 'Game' AND "e".event_name ILIKE '%Football%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "m2".major_name) AS "majors_without_enrolled_members" FROM "major" AS "m1" INNER JOIN "member" AS "target_member" ON "target_member".link_to_major = "m1".major_id INNER JOIN "major" AS "m2" ON "m2".college = "m1".college WHERE "target_member".first_name = 'Tyler' AND "target_member".last_name = 'Hewitt' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" AS "enrolled" WHERE "enrolled".link_to_major = "m2".major_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendee_count), 2) AS "average_attendees_per_event" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "budget" AS "b" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "b".link_to_event WHERE "b".category ILIKE 'Advertisement' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "event_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".type = 'Budget' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".location ORDER BY "e".event_date ASC, "e".event_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "attendee_counts" AS (SELECT "m".link_to_major, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "a".link_to_event INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "a".link_to_member WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "m".link_to_major), "ranked" AS (SELECT "ac".attendee_count, "maj".major_name, MAX("ac".attendee_count) OVER () AS "max_attendee_count" FROM "attendee_counts" AS "ac" INNER JOIN "major" AS "maj" ON "maj".major_id = "ac".link_to_major) SELECT major_name, attendee_count FROM "ranked" WHERE attendee_count = max_attendee_count ORDER BY major_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" AS "m" WHERE "m".link_to_major = "maj".major_id)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_of_majors_without_members" FROM "major" AS "maj" LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "m".position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN 'officers' ELSE 'other students' END AS "group_name", ROUND(AVG("member_counts".event_count), 2) AS "average_events_attended" FROM (SELECT "m".member_id, "m".position, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) AS "event_count" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".position) AS "member_counts" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "member_counts".member_id GROUP BY CASE WHEN "m".position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN 'officers' ELSE 'other students' END LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%water%' THEN 'water' END) + COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%pizza%' THEN 'pizza' END) + COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%posters%' OR "x".expense_description ILIKE '%post cards%' THEN 'posters' END) + COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%donuts%' OR "x".expense_description ILIKE '%muffins%' THEN 'donuts/muffins' END) + COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%cookies%' THEN 'cookies' END) + COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%veggie tray%' THEN 'veggie tray' END) + COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%' THEN 'chips' END) + COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%club shirts%' THEN 'club shirts' END) + COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%parking%' THEN 'parking' END) + COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%alumni glass%' THEN 'alumni glass' END) + COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "x".expense_description ILIKE '%travel mug%' THEN 'travel mug' END) AS "count" FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "x".link_to_budget INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "b".link_to_event WHERE "b".amount - "b".spent < 0 AND "e".event_date >= '2019-08-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "ev".event_name, ROUND(COALESCE("water".cost, 0)::NUMERIC / "attendee".attendee_count, 2) AS "amount_spent_per_attendee" FROM "event" AS "ev" INNER JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(*) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "attendee" ON "attendee".link_to_event = "ev".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("ex".cost) AS "cost" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "ex" ON "ex".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "ex".expense_description IN ('Water, Cookies', 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies', 'Water, chips, cookies', 'Water, cookies, chips') GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "water" ON "water".link_to_event = "ev".event_id LIMIT 501

WITH "college_major_counts" AS (SELECT "maj".college, COUNT(DISTINCT "maj".major_id) AS "number_of_majors" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "major" AS "maj" ON "maj".major_id = "m".link_to_major GROUP BY "maj".college), "ranked" AS (SELECT college, number_of_majors, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY number_of_majors DESC) AS "rnk" FROM "college_major_counts") SELECT college, number_of_majors FROM "ranked" WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY college ASC LIMIT 501
