SELECT ROUND(AVG("h".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "h".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_hp" ON "target_hp".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "target_hp".hero_id WHERE "h".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "h".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'No Colour') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue') AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F'), 0) AS "male_to_female_ratio" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE ("p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0) OR ("p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".alb)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "average_alb" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".plt > 400 AND "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".tg >= 200 AND "l".date = DATE '2026-10-09' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1976-10-10' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".glu >= 180 AND "l"."T-CHO" < 250 AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hct >= 52 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".birthday HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "female_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday < DATE '1971-10-09' AND "l".pt >= 14 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".crp LIKE '%+%' AND "p".description IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') AND "e".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

WITH "strongest" AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN "rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "rnp"::INTEGER END) AS "max_rnp" FROM "laboratory"), "candidates" AS (SELECT "l"."id", "l"."date", "l"."T-BIL", "l"."rnp" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" CROSS JOIN "strongest" AS "s" WHERE "l"."rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l"."rnp"::INTEGER = "s".max_rnp AND "l"."T-BIL" IS NOT NULL), "max_bil" AS (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") AS "max_total_bilirubin" FROM "candidates") SELECT "c"."T-BIL", "c"."date", "c"."id", "p"."sex", "p"."birthday" FROM "candidates" AS "c" INNER JOIN "max_bil" AS "b" ON "c"."T-BIL" = "b".max_total_bilirubin INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "c"."id" = "p"."id" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "examination" WHERE thrombosis > 0) AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER > 10) AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1960-01-01' AND "e".id IS NOT NULL AND "r".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "l".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative'), "titers" AS (SELECT "e".id, MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) AS "anti_rnp_titer" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' GROUP BY "e".id) SELECT id, MAX(anti_rnp_titer) AS "anti_rnp_titer" FROM "titers" GROUP BY id HAVING MAX(anti_rnp_titer) = (SELECT MAX(anti_rnp_titer) FROM "titers") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "plt_lab" ON "plt_lab".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "rnp_lab" ON "rnp_lab".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'MCTD' AND "plt_lab".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "rnp_lab".rnp IN ('15', '16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".test_dates, 0)), 2) AS "avg_laboratory_test_dates" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS "test_dates" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "e".id IS NULL GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".dna, CASE WHEN "l".dna SIMILAR TO '[+-]?[0-9]+(.[0-9]+)?' THEN "l".dna::NUMERIC END AS "dna_level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '+(')), "highest" AS (SELECT MAX(dna_level) AS "max_level" FROM "eligible") SELECT "e".id, "e".date, "e".dna FROM "eligible" AS "e" CROSS JOIN "highest" AS "h" WHERE "e".dna_level = "h".max_level ORDER BY "e".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp IN ('16', '64', '256') AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "h".id) AS "count" FROM "laboratory" AS "h" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "h".id WHERE "h".hct IS NOT NULL AND ("h".hct <= 29 OR "h".hct >= 52) AND "r".rnp IN ('64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "normal_patients".id IS NOT NULL THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_normal_platelet", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "normal_patients".id IS NULL THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_never_with_normal_platelet" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE plt > 100 AND plt < 400) AS "normal_patients" ON "normal_patients".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis IN ('RA,SJS', 'SJS,RA') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp - 8.5)::NUMERIC, 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".tp > 8.5 AND "p".id IN (SELECT "e".id FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".rnp NOT IN ('negative', '0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64')) / NULLIF(COUNT("l".rnp), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=1000')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)::INTEGER) AS "youngest_age_years" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 64 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT("l".id) AS "total_laboratory_tests", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_laboratory_tests" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "e".thrombosis = 1 AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".symptoms ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" WHERE thrombosis = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e".first_exam_date - "p"."First Date")) AS "average_delay_days" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MIN("Examination Date") AS "first_exam_date" FROM "examination" GROUP BY id) AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "l".id AS "patient ID", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "completed age" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND ("l"."U-PRO" = '300' OR "l"."U-PRO" = '>=300' OR "l"."U-PRO" = '>=1000' OR "l"."U-PRO" = '+2(100)' AND 100 >= 300 OR "l"."U-PRO" = '+1(30)') ORDER BY "l".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "difference" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE un < 30) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'RA' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_out_of_range_creatinine", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "patient_max" AS (SELECT "p".admission, "l".id, MAX("l"."T-CHO") AS "highest_t_cho" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".admission, "l".id), "group_max" AS (SELECT admission, MAX(highest_t_cho) AS "highest_t_cho" FROM "patient_max" GROUP BY admission) SELECT "pm".highest_t_cho AS "T-CHO", "pm".admission AS "admission_status", "pm".id AS "patient_id" FROM "patient_max" AS "pm" INNER JOIN "group_max" AS "gm" ON "gm".admission = "pm".admission AND "gm".highest_t_cho = "pm".highest_t_cho ORDER BY CASE "pm".admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END ASC, "pm".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "patient_levels" AS (SELECT "p".id, MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) AS "rnp_level" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' GROUP BY "p".id), "highest" AS (SELECT MAX(rnp_level) AS "rnp_level" FROM "patient_levels") SELECT id, rnp_level AS "anti-RNP level" FROM "patient_levels" WHERE rnp_level = (SELECT rnp_level FROM "highest") ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT AVG(hct) FROM "laboratory" WHERE date >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND date < DATE '1992-01-01' AND hct IS NOT NULL AND ("U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') OR "U-PRO" = '4') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'SLE' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-', '+(') AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)') GROUP BY "p".admission LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rf IN ('-', '+-') AND "p".id NOT IN (SELECT "e".id FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".kct = '+' OR "e".rvvt = '+' OR "e".lac = '+') LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_samples" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_scl70" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, sc170 FROM "laboratory" ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC) SELECT "ls".id FROM "latest_samples" AS "ls" INNER JOIN "latest_scl70" AS "l70" ON "l70".id = "ls".id WHERE "ls".latest_date > DATE '1997-01-01' AND "l70".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" GROUP BY "l".id HAVING BOOL_OR("l".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "l".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')) AND BOOL_OR("l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', ''))) AS "qualified_patients" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l"."DNA-II" < 8 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission <> '-' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CAST("rnp" AS INTEGER)) FROM "laboratory" WHERE "cre" < 1.5 AND "rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hgb < 7.0 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT "p".id, "l".date, "l".rnp FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".got >= 60 AND "l".rnp = '256' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450 OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient group", COUNT(*) AS "number of normal-range LDH measurements" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".ldh < 500 GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NOT NULL) AS "patients_with_lab_result", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0) AS "patients_with_elevated_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL OR "p".sex = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "anemia" ON "anemia".id = "p".id AND "anemia".hgb < 10 WHERE "p".admission = '-' GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex), "scored" AS (SELECT "e".id, "e".sex, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::INTEGER END) AS "highest_rnp" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id GROUP BY "e".id, "e".sex) SELECT id, sex, highest_rnp FROM "scored" WHERE highest_rnp = (SELECT MAX(highest_rnp) FROM "scored") LIMIT 501
WITH "first_lab" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, got, rnp FROM "laboratory" ORDER BY id ASC, date ASC) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "first_lab" WHERE got < 60 AND rnp IN ('15', '16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "l".date, "l"."U-PRO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id) AS "latest" ON "latest".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "latest".id AND "l".date = "latest".latest_date AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".cpk < 250 AND "l".rnp NOT IN ('negative', '0', '1', '4') LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "l".id = "e".id WHERE "l".rnp <> '0' AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 16 GROUP BY "l".id), "normal_gpt" AS (SELECT "l".id, MAX("l".gpt) AS "max_normal_gpt" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "eligible" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "l".gpt < 60 GROUP BY "l".id) SELECT "p".birthday AS "Birthday" FROM "normal_gpt" AS "n" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "n".id ORDER BY "n".max_normal_gpt DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".pt < 14 AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 16 LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE("l".date, "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "age", "p".diagnosis FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".dna DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%susp%' ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN "p".id END) AS "elevated_patients", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".rnp IS NULL THEN "p".id END) AS "no_elevated_result" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('4', '15', '16', '64', '256')) AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "e".id IS NULL WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END ORDER BY care_setting ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND (SELECT "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC LIMIT 1) >= 2000 LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_visits" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_results" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "latest_visits" AS "v" ON "l".id = "v".id AND "l".date = "v".latest_date) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "difference" FROM "latest_results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "r".id WHERE "r".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "r".rnp::INTEGER >= 32 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".rnp, "l".cpk FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date DESC) AS "most_recent" WHERE "most_recent".rnp::INTEGER > 64 AND "most_recent".cpk < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(CASE WHEN ldh >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "has_ldh", MAX(CASE WHEN "U-PRO" IN ('100', '300', '+2(100)', '>=300', '>=1000') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "has_protein" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "q" ON "q".id = "p".id WHERE "q".has_ldh = 1 AND "q".has_protein = 1 ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex AS "sex", COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, "p".diagnosis FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "e".symptoms <> '' ORDER BY "p".birthday ASC, "p".id ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') ORDER BY ("p"."First Date" - "p".birthday) DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rbc < 3.5 AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY CASE "p".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SJS%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SJS susp%' AND "e"."aCL IgM" > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) AS "count" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis LIKE '%SjS%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT LIKE '%SjS susp%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND ("l".rnp = 'negative' OR "l".rnp = '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "sm_lab" ON "sm_lab".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "pro_lab" ON "pro_lab".id = "p".id WHERE "sm_lab".sm IN ('negative', '0') AND "e".thrombosis = 0 AND "pro_lab"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l_rbc" ON "l_rbc".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l_rnp" ON "l_rnp".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l_rbc".rbc IS NOT NULL AND ("l_rbc".rbc <= 3.5 OR "l_rbc".rbc >= 6.0) AND "l_rnp".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l_rnp".rnp <> '0' AND "l_rnp".rnp <> 'negative' ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG((DATE '2026-10-09' - "p".birthday) / 365.2425::NUMERIC), 1) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('64', '256')) AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday > DATE '1956-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".wbc > 3.5 AND "l".wbc < 9.0 AND ("l".fg <= 150 OR "l".fg >= 450) AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 15 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M')), 0), 1) AS "women percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE("l".date, "p".birthday)) < 50 AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'o') AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "single_bond_molecules" ON "single_bond_molecules".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS "average_single_bonds_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "carcinogenic_single_bond_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "a2".molecule_id = "m2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts_by_element") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_no_fluorine" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".bond_type FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '#') AND "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT "p".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "p" WHERE "p".element IN ('p', 'br')) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "chlorine_percentage" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS "hydrogen_atom_fraction", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT bond_group, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '+') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '-') AS "carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label, CASE WHEN COALESCE(BOOL_AND("b".bond_type = '-'), TRUE) THEN 'every bond is a single bond' ELSE 'all other molecules' END AS "bond_group" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label) AS "classified_molecules" GROUP BY bond_group LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_carbon_carbon_double_bond_pairs" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "c".atom_id = "a1".atom_id AND "a1".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id AND "a2".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '=' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' LIMIT 501

WITH "bonded_atoms" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".atom_id, "a".molecule_id, "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+'), "element_counts" AS (SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS "bonded_count" FROM "bonded_atoms" GROUP BY element), "total_atoms" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+'), "ranked" AS (SELECT element, bonded_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY bonded_count DESC) AS "rnk" FROM "element_counts") SELECT "r".element, ROUND(100.0 * "r".bonded_count / "t".total_count, 2) AS "percentage_of_all_atoms" FROM "ranked" AS "r" CROSS JOIN "total_atoms" AS "t" WHERE "r".rnk = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT("b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM (SELECT "b".bond_type FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' GROUP BY "b".bond_id, "b".bond_type) AS "cc" GROUP BY bond_type LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id2 ELSE "c".atom_id END) AS "count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON ("a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2) WHERE "a".element = 'cl' AND (CASE WHEN "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id THEN "c".atom_id2 ELSE "c".atom_id END) <> "a".atom_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a".element = 's' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "other_a" ON "other_a".element = "a".element AND "other_a".molecule_id <> "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "other_a".atom_id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "n".molecule_id) FROM "atom" AS "n" WHERE "n".element = 'n' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE ("c".atom_id = "n".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "n".atom_id) AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "other_n" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "other_n".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "other_n".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "other_n".molecule_id = "n".molecule_id AND "other_n".element = 'n' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c"."atom_id2") AS "count" FROM "atom" AS "cl_atom" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c"."atom_id" = "cl_atom"."atom_id" WHERE "cl_atom"."element" = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".label, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "b".molecule_id) FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '#'), 2) AS "percent" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "m".label LIMIT 501

WITH "rare_elements" AS (SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) = 1), "rare_atoms" AS (SELECT "a".atom_id, "a".molecule_id, "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "rare_elements" AS "r" ON "r".element = "a".element), "rare_bond_counts" AS (SELECT "ra".molecule_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "rare_atoms" AS "ra" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "ra".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "ra".atom_id GROUP BY "ra".molecule_id) SELECT "rbc".molecule_id, "rbc".bond_count FROM "rare_bond_counts" AS "rbc" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "rbc".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' ORDER BY "rbc".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "atom_counts" AS (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_atoms", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'c') AS "number_of_carbon_atoms", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'cl') AS "number_of_chlorine_atoms" FROM "atom" GROUP BY molecule_id), "bond_counts" AS (SELECT "b".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_bonds", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "number_of_multiple_bonds", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a1".element = 'c' OR "a2".element = 'c') AS "number_of_carbon_touching_bonds" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 GROUP BY "b".molecule_id) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "bc".number_of_carbon_touching_bonds DESC, "ac".number_of_atoms DESC, "m".molecule_id ASC) AS "rank", "m".molecule_id, "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label", "ac".number_of_atoms, COALESCE("bc".number_of_bonds, 0) AS "number_of_bonds", "ac".number_of_carbon_atoms, "ac".number_of_chlorine_atoms, COALESCE("bc".number_of_carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS "number_of_carbon_touching_bonds", COALESCE("bc".number_of_multiple_bonds, 0) AS "number_of_multiple_bonds" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom_counts" AS "ac" ON "ac".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond_counts" AS "bc" ON "bc".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "ac".number_of_carbon_atoms > 0 ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "h" ON ("h".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "h".atom_id = "c".atom_id2) WHERE "b".molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM "atom" WHERE element = 'y') AND "h".element = 'h' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("atom_bond_counts".bond_count), 2) AS "average_bonds_per_atom" FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "atom_bond_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a2".element AS "element", COUNT(*) AS "count_of_bonds" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') GROUP BY "a2".element ORDER BY "a2".element ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "selected_bonds" AS (SELECT "b".bond_id, "b".bond_type FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=')), "bond_element_pairs" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "sb".bond_id, "sb".bond_type, LEAST("a1".element, "a2".element) AS "element_1", GREATEST("a1".element, "a2".element) AS "element_2" FROM "selected_bonds" AS "sb" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "sb".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2), "bond_counts" AS (SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS "bond_count" FROM "selected_bonds" GROUP BY bond_type), "pair_counts" AS (SELECT bond_type, COUNT(DISTINCT (element_1, element_2)) AS "element_pair_count" FROM "bond_element_pairs" GROUP BY bond_type) SELECT "bc".bond_type AS "bond_kind", "bc".bond_count, COALESCE("pc".element_pair_count, 0) AS "element_pair_count", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "bond_counts" AS "bc" LEFT JOIN "pair_counts" AS "pc" ON "pc".bond_type = "bc".bond_type INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = 'TR377' ORDER BY "bc".bond_count DESC, "bc".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb') AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "cm" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "bm" ON "bm".bond_id = "cm".bond_id WHERE "cm".atom_id = "a".atom_id AND "bm".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
